# IAMTrail

> Unofficial archive of every change to AWS Managed IAM Policies since 2019, with full version history and diffs across 1,500+ policies and 400+ AWS services, plus AWS endpoint and GuardDuty announcement change feeds.

AWS updates its Managed IAM Policies silently and does not publish a changelog. IAMTrail archives every version so you can see exactly what changed, when, and in which policy. Free, open source, and no account required.

Made by zoph.io (https://zoph.io), an independent AWS consulting boutique founded by Victor Grenu.

IAMTrail is an unofficial archive and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon Web Services. AWS and related marks are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://iamtrail.com/): Dashboard with archive stats, recently changed policies, and charts.
- [Changes](https://iamtrail.com/changes): Reverse-chronological timeline of every recorded policy change, searchable and filterable.
- [Policies](https://iamtrail.com/policies): Full searchable list of tracked AWS Managed IAM Policies. Also the site search endpoint, at /policies?q=, which accepts a policy name or an IAM action such as s3:GetObject.
- [Discoveries](https://iamtrail.com/discoveries): Never-before-seen IAM actions and new AWS services, as they first appear in a managed policy.
- [Brand new policies](https://iamtrail.com/brand-new): Policies still on their first version.
- [Deprecated policies](https://iamtrail.com/deprecated): Policies AWS has deprecated.
- [Most active policies](https://iamtrail.com/most-active): Policies with the most revisions.
- [Largest policies](https://iamtrail.com/largest-policies): Policies with the most actions.
- [Service growth](https://iamtrail.com/service-growth): AWS service namespace growth over time.
- [Endpoints](https://iamtrail.com/endpoints): AWS endpoint changes from botocore, covering new regions, services, and expansions.
- [GuardDuty](https://iamtrail.com/guardduty): GuardDuty announcements for new findings, features, and regions.
- [Account lookup](https://iamtrail.com/accounts): Identify the owners of one or many AWS account IDs at once, powered by the fwdcloudsec/known_aws_accounts dataset.
- [Security findings](https://iamtrail.com/findings): IAM Access Analyzer findings and pathfinding.cloud path overlap.
- [Subscribe](https://iamtrail.com/subscribe): Email digest of policy changes. Double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe.
- [Feeds](https://iamtrail.com/feeds): Directory of every RSS feed and the other notification channels.
- [JSON API](https://iamtrail.com/api): Free, versioned, static JSON endpoints under /api/v1/. No key, no sign-up.
- [Usage stats](https://iamtrail.com/usage): Aggregate notification usage, showing how many readers the digests reach.
- [About](https://iamtrail.com/about): How the archive works, credits, and disclaimer.

## Machine-readable feeds

- [All changes (RSS)](https://iamtrail.com/feeds/all.xml)
- [IAM policy changes (RSS)](https://iamtrail.com/feeds/iam-policies.xml)
- [Endpoint changes (RSS)](https://iamtrail.com/feeds/endpoints.xml)
- [GuardDuty announcements (RSS)](https://iamtrail.com/feeds/guardduty.xml)
- [Source and raw policy history](https://github.com/zoph-io/IAMTrail): Every policy version is committed to git, so the full diff history is browsable on GitHub.

## The zoph.io galaxy

All of the following are operated by Victor Grenu through zoph.io, an independent AWS consulting boutique.

- [zoph.io](https://zoph.io): The consulting boutique. AWS architecture, security audits and hardening, automation and DevSecOps, cloud cost optimization, and secure AI and LLM adoption.
- [zoph.me](https://zoph.me): Personal weblog on AWS, IAM, cloud security, architecture, automation, FinOps, and indie consulting.
- [unusd.cloud](https://unusd.cloud): SaaS that runs read-only AWS cost and waste scans across 30+ services and every region, with a weekly digest email and Navi, an AI layer grounded in your scan findings.
- [IAMTrail](https://iamtrail.com): Archive of every change to AWS Managed IAM Policies since 2019, with full version history and diffs, plus AWS endpoint and GuardDuty change feeds.
- [github.com/zoph-io](https://github.com/zoph-io): Open-source AWS tooling, including ClickOps Sentinel, AWS Security Survival Kit, AWS Trustline, and Subnet-Watcher.
- [fwd:cloudsec Europe](https://fwdcloudsec.org/conference/europe/): Vendor-neutral cloud security conference. Victor is an organizer and CFP reviewer.
